```{r}
# This function helps extract TPMs for specific samples from your s2c metadata
extract_tpm_matrix <- function(s2c_sub) {
  # Assuming you have loaded your kallisto results into a combined dataframe or sleuth object
  # For this example, we'll assume 'so' is a sleuth object containing all samples
  # Or you can read the abundance.tsv files directly using the 'path' in your s2c
  
  tpm_list <- lapply(s2c_sub$path, function(p) {
    read_tsv(file.path(p, "abundance.tsv"), col_types = cols()) %>%
      select(target_id, tpm)
  })
  
  # Join all samples into one matrix
  df <- reduce(tpm_list, full_join, by = "target_id")
  mat <- as.matrix(df[,-1])
  rownames(mat) <- df$target_id
  colnames(mat) <- s2c_sub$sample
  return(mat)
}

# Filter for your two specific comparisons
s2c_wt <- s2c %>% filter(name %in% c("Guy11", "Guy11M"))
s2c_mut <- s2c %>% filter(name %in% c("mst7", "pmk1"))

mat_wt <- extract_tpm_matrix(s2c_wt)
mat_mut <- extract_tpm_matrix(s2c_mut)
```



```{r}
# 1. Helper function to run and save RP for a specific subset
run_and_save_timepoint_RP <- function(s2c_sub, mat_sub, timepoint_label, experiment_label, group_a, group_b, out_dir) {
  
  message("Processing ", experiment_label, " at ", timepoint_label, "...")
  
  # Define Origin (Batches/Experiments within this timepoint)
  # Even within one timepoint, you have Miriam and Euan data
  origin_vec <- as.numeric(as.factor(s2c_sub$experiment))
  
  # Forward: A=0, B=1
  cl_f <- ifelse(s2c_sub$name == group_a, 0, 1)
  rp_f <- RP(mat_sub, cl_f, num.perm = 100, logged = FALSE, gene.names = rownames(mat_sub))
  
  # Reverse: B=0, A=1
  cl_r <- ifelse(s2c_sub$name == group_b, 0, 1)
  rp_r <- RP(mat_sub, cl_r, num.perm = 100, logged = FALSE, gene.names = rownames(mat_sub))
  
  # Save using our previously defined helper (modified to include timepoint in prefix)
  save_rp_results(rp_f, paste0(experiment_label, "_", group_a, "_vs_", group_b, "_", timepoint_label, "_Forward"), out_dir)
  save_rp_results(rp_r, paste0(experiment_label, "_", group_b, "_vs_", group_a, "_", timepoint_label, "_Reverse"), out_dir)
}

# 2. Main execution loop
timepoints <- unique(s2c$timepoint)

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  # --- WT Comparison (Guy11 vs Guy11M) ---
  s2c_wt_tp <- s2c %>% filter(name %in% c("Guy11", "Guy11M"), timepoint == tp)
  
  if(nrow(s2c_wt_tp) >= 4) { # Need at least 2 vs 2 for a meaningful RP
    mat_wt_tp <- extract_tpm_matrix(s2c_wt_tp)
    run_and_save_timepoint_RP(s2c_wt_tp, mat_wt_tp, tp, "WT", "Guy11", "Guy11M", data_dir)
  }
  
  # --- Mutant Comparison (mst7 vs pmk1) ---
  s2c_mut_tp <- s2c %>% filter(name %in% c("mst7", "pmk1"), timepoint == tp)
  
  if(nrow(s2c_mut_tp) >= 4) {
    mat_mut_tp <- extract_tpm_matrix(s2c_mut_tp)
    run_and_save_timepoint_RP(s2c_mut_tp, mat_mut_tp, tp, "Mutant", "mst7", "pmk1", data_dir)
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Define Paths
data_dir <- "C:/Users/ges23jir/Documents/Coding/TSL/mst7_transcriptome/Analysis/Data/Ranked_product"
fig_dir  <- "C:/Users/ges23jir/Documents/Coding/TSL/mst7_transcriptome/Analysis/Data/Figures/Ranked_product"

# 2. Get the list of files, excluding the old "global" ones without numbers
all_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "_Up_in_Group1.csv", full.names = TRUE)
# This line keeps only files that have a timepoint number before "_Forward"
primary_files <- all_files[str_detect(basename(all_files), "_\\d+_Forward")]

all_counts <- data.frame()

for (f in primary_files) {
  fname <- basename(f)
  
  # A. Extract Timepoint: Look for the number between underscores (e.g., _24_Forward)
  # We use a pattern that finds the digits right before "_Forward"
  tp_num <- str_extract(fname, "(?<=_)\\d+(?=_Forward)")
  tp_label <- paste0(tp_num, "H") # Turn "24" into "24H" for the plot
  
  # B. Detect Experiment
  type <- ifelse(grepl("WT", fname), "Wild-Type", "Mutant")
  
  # C. Read and Count (using lowercase 'pfp' from your screenshot)
  df_up <- read_csv(f, col_types = cols())
  up_count <- sum(df_up$pfp < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # D. Find and Count the "Down" (Group0) file
  f_down <- gsub("Group1.csv", "Group0.csv", f)
  if(file.exists(f_down)) {
    df_down <- read_csv(f_down, col_types = cols())
    down_count <- sum(df_down$pfp < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    down_count <- 0
  }
  
  # E. Build the row
  all_counts <- rbind(all_counts, data.frame(
    Experiment = type,
    Timepoint = tp_label,
    Up = up_count,
    Down = down_count
  ))
}

# 3. Format for Plotting
plot_ready <- all_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Up, Down), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(DisplayCount = ifelse(Direction == "Down", -Count, Count)) %>%
  # Force chronological order
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("0H", "2H", "4H", "24H")))

# 4. Create the Clean Plot
p <- ggplot(plot_ready, aes(x = DisplayCount, y = Timepoint, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + # Add outlines to see bars
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = abs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#d73027", "Down" = "#4575b4")) +
  facet_wrap(~Experiment) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Rank Product DEGs (pfp < 0.05)",
       x = "Number of Genes",
       y = "Hours Post Infection (HPI)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

# 5. Save
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "DEG_Timecourse_Fixed.pdf"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "DEG_Timecourse_Fixed.svg"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 5)

# 6. PRINT THE TABLE SO YOU CAN SEE IT
print("--- Final Counts Table ---")
print(all_counts)
```


```{r}
library(UpSetR)
library(grid)

# 1. Define a function to get gene lists from your files
get_sig_genes <- function(file_path) {
  if(!file.exists(file_path)) return(character(0))
  dat <- read_csv(file_path, col_types = cols())
  return(dat %>% filter(pfp < 0.05) %>% pull(gene.index)) # Using pfp and gene.index from your headers
}

# 2. Loop through each timepoint to create a plot
tps <- c("0", "2", "4", "24")

for (tp in tps) {
  
  # Define file paths for this specific timepoint
  wt_up_f   <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("WT_Guy11_vs_Guy11M_", tp, "_Forward_Up_in_Group1.csv"))
  wt_down_f <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("WT_Guy11_vs_Guy11M_", tp, "_Forward_Up_in_Group0.csv"))
  mut_up_f  <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("Mutant_mst7_vs_pmk1_", tp, "_Forward_Up_in_Group1.csv"))
  mut_down_f <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("Mutant_mst7_vs_pmk1_", tp, "_Forward_Up_in_Group0.csv"))
  
  # Load the gene lists
  gene_lists <- list(
    WT_Up = get_sig_genes(wt_up_f),
    WT_Down = get_sig_genes(wt_down_f),
    Mutant_Up = get_sig_genes(mut_up_f),
    Mutant_Down = get_sig_genes(mut_down_f)
  )
  
  # Only plot if there are actually significant genes to compare
  if(sum(sapply(gene_lists, length)) > 0) {
    
    # Generate the plot
    # We use a PDF/SVG export because UpSet plots can be quite wide
    pdf(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("UpSet_Comparison_", tp, "H.pdf")), width = 10, height = 7)
    
    upset_p <- upset(fromList(gene_lists), 
          order.by = "freq", 
          main.bar.color = "#2c3e50",
          sets.bar.color = "#c0392b",
          text.scale = c(1.3, 1.3, 1, 1, 1.5, 1),
          matrix.color = "#2980b9")
    
    print(upset_p)
    dev.off()
    
    # Also save as SVG
    svglite(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("UpSet_Comparison_", tp, "H.svg")), width = 10, height = 7)
    print(upset_p)
    dev.off()
    
    message("Saved UpSet plot for ", tp, "H")
  } else {
    message("No significant genes found for ", tp, "H - skipping UpSet plot.")
  }
}
```
